hero: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original production background illustration for the German children's reading adventure LeseHelferlein, wide landscape 3:2. Beautiful tactile children's picture book art, softly painted gouache with fine colored-pencil edges and subtle paper grain, carefully art-directed, handmade-looking rather than vector geometry. Warm forest green, sage, honey yellow, pale mint, warm cream, tiny berry-purple accents. A magical woodland reading clearing: ancient curving tree trunks frame far left and right, layered lush botanical foliage, ferns, tiny spotted mushrooms, delicate golden fireflies, a winding sandy path, a charming tiny woodland library built from the shape of an open book on the lower right with a curved moss roof and warm glowing windows. Composition for website: upper left and middle-left 55 percent MUST be very light warm cream/mint open airy clearing with almost no detail for dark headline overlay, no tree silhouettes behind this text zone. Richest lovely details in the bottom 30 percent and far outer edges. Right middle is an uncluttered pale area where an existing fairy asset will be overlaid; do not draw a fairy. Gentle golden morning light, inviting and joyful for children aged 6-9. Distinctive botanical small details, believable hand-painted edges. No people, no characters, no words, no letters, no logo, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Full-bleed scene, not floating geometric islands, not 3D plastic, no stock icons.

stories.name: fox
stories.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A bespoke illustrated game-map location for the German children's reading world LeseHelferlein. Tactile children's picture-book gouache and colored pencil, soft painterly irregular edges, rich little botanical details, warm forest green, sage, honey yellow, cream, small berry purple accents. A single compact beautifully composed vignette isolated on genuinely transparent background with generous empty margin. Three-quarter eye-level view, feels like a little place to visit, not a logo or simple symbol. Entire subject visible. Handmade appearance, coherent storybook art, soft natural shadows contained within vignette. No text, no letters, no UI, no border, no circular badge, no generic vector icon, no plastic 3D. Do not include a fairy or new mascot. Transparent background is essential. Subject: Mondlichtwiese: a snug little woodland fox den beneath a curved tree root, a curled sleeping small fox visible by the entrance (a character in the story, not a brand mascot), a luminous crescent moon hanging over the root, tiny white wildflowers and several gold fireflies. Gentle twilight mint and muted blue behind the small den only, watercolor edges fading to transparency. Cozy and reassuring, never dark or scary.
